articles.headline: Will Lankshear scores brace as Middlesbrough come back to survive scare and beat Lincoln
articles.description: Marquee signing Will Lankshear notched a second-half double as Middlesbrough fought back to kick off their Championship bid with a hard-fought 2-1 victory and inflict a first defeat in eight and a half months on newly promoted Lincoln.

images.credit: Bruce Rollinson/PA Images via Getty Images

images.name: Will Lankshear [1296x729]
images.caption: Will Lankshear scored his first Championship goal for Middlesbrough to level the scores.

articles.headline: Nestory Irankunda leaves Watford for Portuguese giants Sporting CP
articles.description: Australia international Nestory Irankunda will feature in the UEFA Champions League this season after joining Portuguese giants Sporting CP.

images.caption: Nestory Irankunda, who became Australia's youngest scorer at a men's World Cup back in June, has joined Portuguese giants Sporting CP after one season in the Championship with Watford.

articles.headline: Raúl Jiménez marks Wolves return by rescuing draw with Blackburn

articles.headline: Dastan Satpayev signs Chelsea deal, joins Burnley on loan

seasonseries.title: West Bromwich Albion vs. Norwich City

keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Callum Styles (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! West Bromwich Albion 0, Norwich City 1. Oscar Schwartau (Norwich City) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kenny McLean.
Krystian Bielik (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Jed Wallace replaces Isaac Price.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Jayson Molumby replaces Nathaniel Phillips.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Aune Heggebø replaces Josh Maja.
Substitution, Norwich City. Anis Ben Slimane replaces Tony Springett.
Substitution, Norwich City. José Córdoba replaces Harry Darling.
Goal! West Bromwich Albion 0, Norwich City 2. Ali Ahmed (Norwich City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Anis Ben Slimane.
Substitution, Norwich City. Papa Diallo replaces Ali Ahmed.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Alex Mowatt replaces Callum Styles.
Goal! West Bromwich Albion 0, Norwich City 3. Anis Ben Slimane (Norwich City) left footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal.
Substitution, Norwich City. Mathias Kvistgaarden replaces Jovon Makama.
Mikey Johnston (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! West Bromwich Albion 0, Norwich City 4. Ben Chrisene (Norwich City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. George Campbell replaces Krystian Bielik.
